item.title: VARMBLIXT by Sabine Marcelis for IKEA Expands Further
item.description: The VARMBLIXT donut lamp from IKEA is everywhere – designed by Sabine Marcelis, a smart update allows for a whole new level of light control.

item.title: Desktop Wallpaper: March 2026 with Giorgio Cecatto
item.description: Blending architectural rigor with machine-driven line work, Giorgio Cecatto's Desktop Wallpaper for this month extends early 20th-century industrial abstraction into a contemporary algorithmic language.

item.title: This Compact Space Heater Pays its Users
item.description: The game-changing Heatbit Maxi and Maxi Pro switch out traditional coils for new computational hardware that simultaneously mines bitcoin and heats up it surroundings.

item.title: The Inchiostri Exhibition by Ronan Bouroullec and Giorgio Mastinu
item.description: The Inchiostri Exhibition features solid blocks of Murano glass, available in eleven different colors for limitless combinations.

item.title: Printworks and Rosewood Define New State of Play
item.description: Revive your love of the game with the newest collaboration from PRINTWORKS and Rosewood, including playing cards, chess, and backgammon.

item.title: Emergence is a New Kind of Multi-Sensorial Wellness Experience
item.description: London-based neuroscience platform Kinda Studio has teamed up with Manhattan “spa” 113 Spring to launch the personalised meditative service.

item.title: The Raw Elegance and ‘Alpine Brutalism’ of L’Apogee Courchevel
item.description: Kelly Wearstler’s redesign layers New Brutalist geometry with soulful materials and mountain warmth within the dining spaces at L'Apogee Courchevel.

item.title: These Ear Buds Let Users Side Sleep Comfortably
item.description: Side sleepers rejoice. Openhagen’s carefully contoured SleePods make falling asleep with-them-in a lot more convenient.

item.title: Color, Craft, and Calm: 7 Highlights from Shoppe Object 2026
item.description: From candles to coasters to anything in between, Shoppe Object features over 850+ vendors across the range of tabletop and decor.

item.title: Steel House in Denver Embraces Industrial Elements and Nature
item.description: Designed by Morris Adjmi Architects, Steel House references the neighborhood’s industrial past and embraces the Mile High City’s wellness-focused lifestyle.
